title: Allergen Labels (per language)
description: Shape of every data/translations/allergens/<lang>.json file: an object keyed by the allergen `key` from data/allergens.json, so a lookup is O(1) with no join step. `declaration` is present in de, en, es, fr, it and tr; locales that do not yet carry the legal sentence omit the field rather than guess it, and consumers should fall back to another locale.

declaration.description: The legal group declaration sentence, identical for every member of a group, e.g. 'Enthält Getreide und glutenhaltige Erzeugnisse'. Render once per group, not once per member.
